scope: Staged ordinary-event/session-log emission envelopes and session queue option admission

paired.comparison: Actual pinned Reporter constructors plus intercepted logger.emit calls; Native pure factories. Includes exact Source session content JSON, enum lookup/defaults, reserved metadata and independent queue/byte settings.

verification.native: 3 passed: corpus, frozen canonical content/reserved fields and arbitrary Python integer rejection.
verification.scope_reason: Pure record construction/admission only. Pinned OTel package tests supply current reference diagnostics; their HTTP/queue results are not Native parity evidence.

behavior: Session content captures the complete canonical event as ECMAScript JSON text, including numeric-key ordering and Unicode; sessionId/content attributes belong to the reporter.
Session occurrence and observation times both retain the canonical event time; ordinary-event observation time is assigned at emission.
Severity defaults to INFO and follows the pinned enum property lookup, including numeric-name reverse entries at the observed boundary.
Session maxRequestBytes is bounded by 4000000; positive signed-31-bit processor fields and batch <= queue are admitted before a pipeline can be built.
diagnostics: The initial comparison exposed TypeScript numeric-enum reverse lookup for a string INFO severity. Native now matches the actual emission boundary; downstream SDK type admission is separate.
limitations: These factories are staged and do not replace the legacy Python SDK backend yet.
HTTP OTLP JSON serialization, batching, retries/cancellation, reporter shutdown and the actual otel service remain follow-up integration work.
No full migration, Portable/browser or Windows 7 release qualification is claimed.
